openwrt_wiki.beschreibung: A MediaTek MT7621AT based 802.11bgn + 802.11ac + mPCIe + USB 3.0 + microSD + SIM slot network appliance.
openwrt_wiki.andere_namen: Also marketed as Cioswi CSW-WR646 or Digineo AC1200 Pro.
openwrt_wiki.sata: This device has an optional, internal SATA3 port. If you want that, make sure it's included by your seller.
openwrt_wiki.modem: The Router has a SIM card slot on the side and is also offered with a bundled miniPCIe LTE modem.
openwrt_wiki.lte_antennen: The WG3526 is optionally sold as a bundle with an internal miniPCIe cellular card. These are usually distinguishable by having 6 instead of 4 antennas.
openwrt_wiki.installation: The device already has a customized version of OpenWrt pre-installed. See installation instructions for the wg2626 as this is basically the same device. It involves booting the router into recovery mode and uploading the image through the Chinese recovery page. If you upload the OpenWrt image through the original web interface, you will get an 'incorrect model' message.
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout: m25p80 spi0.0: w25q128 16384KiB; mtd0 u-boot 192KiB, mtd1 u-boot-env 64KiB, mtd2 factory 64KiB, mtd4 firmware 16064KiB (16M-Gerät)
openwrt_wiki.netzwerk_standard: br-lan 192.168.1.1/24; eth0.1 LAN 1-4; eth0.2 WAN DHCP; WLAN aus
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse_oeffnen: To remove the cover and open the device, just flip it over and remove the 3 screws on the bottom. The center screw may be hidden beneath a warranty seal sticker--remove that. Then you can slide open the case.
openwrt_wiki.seriell: You'll need an USB-TTL converter with pins to plug into the holes in the board. Serial connection parameters: 115200, 8N1
openwrt_wiki.jtag: The JTAG port is the 2 rows of 3 holes to the lower right of the miniPCIe Card (see photo above).
openwrt_wiki.bootlog_auszug: Linux 4.14.180; SoC Type: MediaTek MT7621 ver:1 eco:3; MIPS: machine is ZBT-WG3526 (16M); Memory: 512048K/524288K; CPU Clock: 880MHz; m25p80 spi0.0: w25q128 (16384 Kbytes); mtk_soc_eth loaded mt7530 driver; xhci-mtk Host supports USB 3.0 SuperSpeed; mt7603e ASIC revision 76030010; mt76x2e ASIC revision 76120044; Kernel command line: console=ttyS0,115200

openwrt_git_16m.nachricht: ramips: Add support for ZBT WG3526. The WG3526 is the follow-up to the 2626 and is mostly the same, with the excaption that the mt7602 has been replaced with the mt7603. The internal wifi setup has also changed slightly.
openwrt_git_16m.dts: memory reg <0x0 0x1c000000>, <0x20000000 0x4000000>; bootargs console=ttyS0,115200; sdhci okay; SPI-NOR m25p80 10 MHz; Partitionen u-boot 0x30000, u-boot-env 0x10000, factory 0x10000, firmware 0x50000+0xfb0000; pcie0 mt76 eeprom factory 0x0000 (5ghz=0), pcie1 mt76 eeprom factory 0x8000 (2ghz=0); MAC factory 0xe000; reset gpio0 18; LED zbt-wg3526:green:status gpio0 24

openwrt_git_ac1200pro.nachricht: ramips: add support for Digineo AC1200 Pro. This is basically a ZBT-WG3526 (mt7621 SoC), but with 32M flash.
openwrt_git_ac1200pro.image: IMAGE_SIZE ralink_default_fw_size_32M; DEVICE_PACKAGES kmod-usb3 kmod-ledtrig-usbdev kmod-ata-core kmod-ata-ahci

openwrt_git_varianten.nachricht: ramips: prepare ZBT-WG3526 for hardware variants. The ZBT-WG3526 is available with 16 or 32 MByte of flash. Rename the current supported 16MByte version to indicate which flash size variant is supported.

openwrt_git_32m.nachricht: ramips: rename Digineo AC1200 Pro to ZBT-WG3526 32MB. The Digineo AC1200 Pro is the 32MB flash variant of the ZBT-WG3526 with unpopulated/exposed sdhci slot. Rename to board to the OEM/ODM name and add the sdhci kernel module to use it for multiple clones.
openwrt_git_32m.image: DEVICE_TITLE ZBT WG3526 (32MB flash); SUPPORTED_DEVICES += ac1200pro; DEVICE_PACKAGES kmod-usb3 kmod-usb-ledtrig-usbport kmod-ata-core kmod-ata-ahci kmod-sdhci-mt7620

openwrt_git_5gled.nachricht: ramips: mt7621: fix 5GHz WiFi LED on ZBT WG3526. This fixes the 5GHz WiFi LED which was previously not working.

openwrt_git_lzma.nachricht: ramips: mt7621: use lzma-loader for ZBT-WG3526. The wg3526 fails to boot if the kernel is large. Enabling lzma-loader resolves the issue on both the wg3526-16m and wg3526-32m. Fixes: FS#3143

openwrt_git_flashreset.nachricht: ramips: fix reboot for remaining 32 MB boards. The following devices have a Winbond W25Q256FV flash chip, which does not have the RESET pin enabled by default ... This commit adds the property for remaining affected devices in ramips target, specifically because of the flash chip model.

zbtlink_datenblatt.titel: Specification, Mode: ZBT-WG 3526, Description: Gigabit 3G&4G Wifi Router, Version: V3.1 (2017.7.19, Haibin Tang)
zbtlink_datenblatt.Simply Description: ZBT-WG3526 is used new MT7621 wireless solution ... Max transmission rate could be 1200Mbps (the 11ac PCIE mode is necessary). 2.4G 300Mbps, 5G will be 880M(Max). Also supports 3G/4G (3G/4G MINI-PCIE module is necessary). It could also dial-up via the USB port. Provide 1 USB2.0 interface, 1* Micro slot.
zbtlink_datenblatt.Product Feature: Support 80.11ac / 802.11a / 802.11n / 802.11g / 802.11b, max 1200Mbps (2.4G 300Mbps + 5G 867Mbps); Support 802.113 / 802.11u protocol, 5* 10/100Mbps Auto MDI/MDIX; 1 USB 2.0 date interface; 1 Micro TF Card Slot; Support 3G/4G (an option, need install with MINI-PCIE 3G/4G module); Support 11AC, dual band (an option, need install with MINI-PCIE 5G module)
zbtlink_datenblatt.Interface: 1* PCI-E slot; 1 *SIM card slot; 1 *USB 3.0 port; 1 *Micro TF card slot; 1 *10/100M/1000M WAN port (Auto MDI/MDIX); 4 *10/100M/1000M LAN port (Auto MDI/MDIX)
